_comment: Loaded by crew-hub via --settings, so the Telegram plugin is enabled for the HUB SESSION ONLY. Do not enable telegram in ~/.claude/settings.json: the plugin's .mcp.json spawns a bun server in every session that has it, Telegram allows exactly one getUpdates consumer per token, and each new server SIGTERMs whoever holds bot.pid — so any other session silently kills the hub's channel.
